description:
Overview:  

The Process \& Quality Specialist – HR Shared Services (HRSS) is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and compliance of HR transactions and processes delivered through the shared services model. The role focuses on process quality audits, SLA/KPI governance, continuous improvement, and enhancing the employee experience through data\-driven insights and quality interventions.


Responsibilities:  

Key Responsibilities


Quality Audits \& Compliance

* Perform regular audits of HRSS transactions (e.g., Global onboarding \& BGV, employee data management (ERP), payroll inputs, compensation \& benefits administration, contract management, Regional HR processes, offboarding).
* Ensure adherence to defined SOPs, process guidelines, compliance requirements, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Identify errors, root causes, and recommend corrective/preventive actions.
* Maintain and update audit checklists and quality frameworks.

Process Improvement \& Standardization

* Drive continuous improvement using methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, PDCA, or similar.
* Partner with process owners to standardize workflows and optimize HRSS operations.
* Support creation, review, and updates of SOPs, process maps, and training documents.
* Facilitate best practice sharing across HRSS teams.

Metrics, Reporting \& Governance

* Track and report quality KPIs (accuracy %, defect rate, rework rate, productivity leakage, SLA compliance).
* Provide monthly/quarterly dashboards and insights to leadership.
* Conduct trend analysis to identify systemic quality gaps.

Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with HRBPs, CoEs, Finance, IT, and external partners to resolve quality issues.
* Participate in governance reviews, calibration sessions, and continuous improvement workshops.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on quality standards and audit requirements.

Training \& Capability Building

* Conduct refresher training based on audit findings and skill gaps.
* Support new hire induction on HRSS processes and quality expectations.
* Reinforce compliance and documentation discipline within teams.
  


Requirements:

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.
* 2\-3 years of experience in HR Shared Services, HR Operations, or Quality Assurance roles.
* Experience with HR systems (HRMS tools, Oracle HCM, ServiceNow, etc.).
* Certification in Lean/Six Sigma (Green Belt preferred) is an advantage.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
* Analytical mindset with expertise in Excel, reporting tools, and audit techniques.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and problem\-solving ability.
* High attention to detail, accuracy, and process discipline.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, multi\-country shared services environments.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Transaction accuracy %
* Defect rate/rework rate
* SLA adherence
* Reduction in recurring errors
* Timeliness of audit and reporting
* Compliance adherence
* Process improvement impact

title: Personal Assistant
description:
— Role Summary —

We're looking for a highly organised, proactive, and trustworthy Personal Assistant to serve as the right hand to the Director across all personal and professional responsibilities. This is NOT a conventional desk job — it requires full\-day physical presence at the office or alongside the Director. You'll manage everything from household coordination to high\-level business communication, ensuring nothing — however big or small — falls through the cracks. The ideal candidate has strong communication skills (English, Hindi, Gujarati), sharp organisational abilities, and the willingness to go above and beyond.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

— A. Personal \& Household Responsibilities —

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

A1\. Daily Schedule \& Calendar Management

You will own the Director's entire daily calendar — meetings, appointments, personal commitments, and family events. This includes setting reminders, coordinating with family members to avoid scheduling conflicts, and proactively briefing the Director each morning on the day's agenda.

A2\. Travel \& Trip Management

You'll handle end\-to\-end travel planning — researching and booking flights, hotels, transfers, visa documentation, and travel insurance for both business and family trips. You'll prepare detailed day\-by\-day itineraries, manage restaurant and activity bookings, and handle post\-travel tasks like expense reconciliation and loyalty programme tracking.

A3\. Household \& Family Coordination

You'll coordinate with household staff and service providers (AC technicians, plumbers, electricians), manage home bill payments (electricity, gas, water, internet, DTH), handle grocery procurement, manage children's school logistics (PTMs, transport, extracurricular activities), and plan family events, birthdays, and festival celebrations including venue, catering, and gifts.

A4\. Personal Errands \& Shopping

You'll run errands on the Director's behalf — bank visits, document collection, government office visits, courier dispatches. You'll also manage personal shopping (gifts, clothing, electronics, medicines) and handle all vehicle\-related tasks like insurance renewal, PUC, servicing, fuel management, and driver coordination.

A5\. Health \& Wellness Coordination

You'll schedule and manage medical appointments for the Director and family, maintain an organised health record file (prescriptions, test reports, insurance documents), manage health insurance claims and renewals, and follow up on medication schedules, regular check\-ups, and dietary commitments.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

— B. Professional \& Business Responsibilities —

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

B1\. Communication Management

You'll be the Director's communication gatekeeper — screening and managing all phone calls, WhatsApp messages, emails, and in\-person visitors. You'll respond to routine queries independently, escalate critical matters, draft business correspondence and price revision notices in English/Hindi/Gujarati, and manage WhatsApp groups and vendor/buyer communication channels. You'll also liaise directly with brokers, weavers, dyeing mills, buyers, and transporters.

B2\. Office Administration \& Operations

You'll keep the Director's office running smoothly — organising files, documents, and physical records systematically, managing couriers and parcels, coordinating with office staff on daily tasks and attendance, handling petty cash and reimbursements, and ensuring the office environment is well\-maintained (housekeeping, supplies, equipment).

B3\. Banking, Finance \& Compliance Support

You'll assist with banking tasks such as cheque deposits, RTGS/NEFT follow\-ups, and bank visits. You'll support TDS compliance, coordinate with the company's CA and accountant for Tally\-related entries, help prepare payroll inputs, track pending payments and receivables from brokers/buyers, and maintain an organised record of all financial documents — bank statements, challans, invoices, and tax filings.

B4\. Inventory, Mill \& Production Coordination

You'll coordinate directly with weaving mills and dyeing mills for dispatch tracking and challan management. This includes monitoring pending dispatch reports, batch processing, and production schedules, following up on fabric processing timelines and quality checks, and helping maintain inventory records and stock movement logs across the Landmark and Millennium market locations.

B5\. Broker \& Sales Coordination

You'll communicate with saree brokers for lot assignments, delivery schedules, and payment follow\-ups. You'll help prepare broker lot reports, colour\-coded sales summaries, and buyer\-wise dispatch records, and coordinate sample dispatches, buyer feedback collection, and market intelligence gathering.

B6\. Meeting \& Visitor Management

You'll schedule and manage all business meetings (internal and external), prepare agendas, collect pre\-meeting materials, take minutes of key discussions, greet and manage office visitors with proper hospitality, and follow up on action items to ensure completion.

B7\. Technology \& Digital Support

You'll help the Director use digital tools — email, cloud storage, calendar apps, and AI tools. You'll coordinate with web developers, social media handlers, and digital marketing consultants for the company's digital presence, support data management tasks (Excel reports, document formatting, digital filing), and coordinate with AI interns or technology consultants working on automation projects.

B8\. Legal \& Statutory Coordination

You'll liaise with advocates and legal consultants on the Director's behalf, track legal deadlines, hearing dates, and compliance filing timelines, maintain an organised legal file of all notices, replies, agreements, and court documents, and assist in translating or summarising legal documents (Gujarati/Hindi to English) when needed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

— C. Investment \& Financial Research Support —

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Organise investment documents (demat statements, P\&L reports, portfolio summaries), coordinate with brokers, advisors \& wealth managers, and support advance tax tracking, STCG/LTCG follow\-ups \& CA liaison for multiple family portfolios.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

— D. Key Qualities Required —

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUST\-Have: Full\-day physical presence, absolute trustworthiness \& discretion, proactive mindset, fluent English/Hindi/Gujarati, strong organisational \& multitasking skills, tech comfort (WhatsApp, Excel, Google Sheets, email), good interpersonal skills, punctuality, own two\-wheeler preferred

Nice\-to\-Have: Prior PA/EA experience in textiles/trading in Surat, familiarity with Surat's market ecosystem, Tally/banking knowledge, AI tools exposure, travel booking platform experience, event planning skills

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

— E. Education \& Experience —

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Graduate in any discipline (BBA/BCA/B.Com preferred; MBA a plus)

1–3 years as PA/EA/Office Coordinator (exceptional freshers may apply)

Languages: English \& Hindi (fluent), Gujarati (preferred)

MS Office, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business

title: Software Dev Engineer I View Jobs
description:
Job Profile: Software Development Engineer I


Location: Bengaluru


Years of Experience: 1 \- 3

 **ABOUT THE TEAM \& ROLE:**


Swiggy is India's largest on\-demand platform for food, groceries, and dining. We're one of the few companies where AI meets physical\-world execution at scale: predicting demand across 5,000\+ dark stores, optimizing millions of deliveries daily, and building agents that operate in real\-time with real constraints


About the Role:


Forward Deployed AI Engineers embed with teams across Swiggy to solve their hardest problems using AI. You'll work in small pods, report into the Central AI team, and deploy to where the problems are: supply chain, category ops, marketplace, support, and beyond.


Think of it as being the AI CTO for the domain you're embedded in.

 **What qualities are we looking for?**

* Why did availability drop 15% in a zone last week? Build the prediction system that prevents it before it happens.
* Ops teams spend 3 days onboarding new catalog items. Can an agent do it in 20 minutes?
* The Dineout discovery bot answers questions but doesn't learn from mistakes. Make it self\-improving.
* Every team wants to build AI products but keeps rebuilding the same infrastructure. Create the foundation they build on.
* Prediction agents for availability, inventory, and demand forecasting
* MCP servers connecting AI to Swiggy's operational systems
* Evaluation frameworks that prove AI impact in production
* Self\-improving agents that learn from ops feedback loops
* Reusable skills and subagent libraries that other teams can deploy
* 60% embedded with business teams (Instamart, Food, Dineout, Customer Support etc)
* 40% Central AI: roadmap input, pattern codification, build platform features
* Rotation model: \~3 month deployments per domain
* Join their standups, map their workflows, find the highest\-leverage problems
* Ship production systems that handle real traffic. Not decks, not demos.
* Package what works into skills and playbooks others can use
* Your field learnings directly shape what the Central AI platform builds next
* You've built and deployed agentic AI systems in production, not just notebooks or demos
* Advanced context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and agent harness patterns
* Experience with skills, subagents, tool integration, and orchestration patterns
* You understand the gap between "it works locally" and "it works at scale with real latency and cost constraints"
* You apply first principles thinking to re\-imagine existing workflows in an AI native way.
* Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex is your primary environment. You ship faster with AI tools than without.
* You think in skills, subagents, and parallel workflows
* You can design an agent architecture, implement it, and iterate based on production feedback
* You've shipped at least one AI system that moved a real business metric. Not incremental, transformative.
* You can show it to us: a repo, a production deployment, metrics before/after, or a recorded demo
* You know what it takes to get from prototype to production
* 2\+ years shipping production systems with real traffic, real users, real constraints (exceptional freshers who are AI power users with proof of work will also be considered)
* OR: Technical founder / early engineer at a startup with demonstrable AI impact
* Trade\-off fluency: latency vs accuracy, cost vs reliability, autonomy vs predictability
* Strong in Python or TypeScript, LLMs, orchestration frameworks, system design
* You translate complex AI concepts to non\-technical ops teams
* You can lead a discovery session, whiteboard an architecture, and get buy\-in in the same meeting
* You write clear documentation that becomes the team's playbook
* You're comfortable context\-switching: ops workflows in the morning, architecture reviews in the afternoon
* You find problems worth solving. You don't wait for specs.
* You ship when the path isn't clear
* You're energized by ambiguity and moving fast in complex environments

 **What will you get to do here?**

  

* Real problems at real scale: Systems that affect millions of orders, thousands of dark stores, and real P\&L
* Direct access: No layers between you and the teams you're solving for. You see the problem, you ship the fix.
* Shape the platform: Your field work defines what the Central AI team builds. Direct input into roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Founder\-like ownership: You're essentially the CTO of AI for your embedded domain
* Career leverage: FDE is the fastest path to becoming a technical leader who understands both AI and operations at scale

 **Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some of the challenges we deal with:**

**Role Overview**We are looking for a highly organized Curriculum Administrator to serve as the primary custodian of our digital curriculum library. You will be responsible for the "architecture" of our cloud storage (Google Drive/SharePoint), ensuring that every lesson, video, and resource is easy to find, correctly versioned, and securely shared. * **Version Control:** Ensure the team is always working on the "Master" file. Archive outdated drafts systematically to prevent the use of obsolete materials.
* **Asset Tagging \& Searchability:** Implement metadata or tagging systems within the Drive to make visual assets (images, icons, b\-roll) instantly searchable.
* **Audit \& Hygiene:** Conduct monthly "Drive Cleanups" to find misplaced files, delete duplicates, and ensure all shared links are still active and secure.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1\+ year in an administrative or operations role (experience in education or EdTech is a plus).
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong command of Google Workspace.
* **Organization:** Exceptional "file hygiene" and the ability to manage multiple projects without losing track of details.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with teachers, designers, and executives.

**Adaptability:** Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment where priorities may shift based on enrollment cycles or feedback.

 The EMR Business Analyst plays a critical role in bridging the gap between healthcare operations and technology solutions. The EMR BA collaborates with stakeholders, including healthcare providers, IT professionals, and administrative staff, to ensure the effective implementation and optimization of EMR systems.

 Elicit and document business requirements from key stakeholders to understand their needs related to EMR functionalities.

**Requirements:** 




 A bachelor's degree in healthcare management, health informatics, business administration, or a related field. Additional certifications in healthcare compliance or informatics are beneficial.
 



 In\-depth understanding of Meaningful Use requirements, CMS regulations, and other healthcare compliance initiatives. Familiarity with EHR systems and health information exchange (HIE) standards.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex regulatory concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly.

 Ability to adapt to changing regulatory requirements and healthcare industry trends.

**REPORTS TO** 



* Business Head \|AGM \- Human Resource



**REPORTING ROLES** 



* Deputy Manager – HR\| Assistant Manager – HR\| Executive/Supervisor/Associate – HR\| HR Interns



**INTERACTS WITH** 



* External – Recruitment agencies, Government authorities, Training Partners, Vendors, Consultants, Auditors.
* Internal – Senior Leadership, Functional Heads, Managers, Supervisors, Rank \& File Associates, Interns, and Contractual Staff.



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Operational Excellence** 



* Drive excellence across end\-to\-end HR operations including hiring, onboarding, HRIS, attendance, policy implementation and offboarding.
* Ensure high standards of accuracy in HR documentation, payroll inputs, and statutory compliance through rigorous data integrity.
* Oversee administration functions including staff amenities, transport, lockers, ID cards, and grievance redressal mechanisms.



  





**Applied Learning** 



* Seeks and makes the most of learning opportunities to improve performance of self and/or others.
* Design and deliver HR\-led learning sessions on key workplace themes such as HR Induction, Code of Conduct, Labor Laws etc.
* Track training completions, feedback scores, and effectiveness using post\-training assessments.



  





**People Management** 



* Serve as the first point of contact for employee relations, ensuring empathetic, confidential, and professional resolution with executive presence.
* Drive talent and performance management through structured appraisals, feedback reviews, and development initiatives aligned with succession planning.
* Conduct exit interviews, analyze attrition trends, gather insights on employee engagement survey scores and provide actionable recommendations to enhance retention and employee engagement.
* Monitor workplace gender diversity metrics and recommend initiatives to strengthen belongingness and equal opportunity.



  





**Business \& Financial Acumen**

description:
**Overview:**

We are looking for a highly motivated Python Developer with a passion for Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), to join our dynamic team. This role is ideal for freshers or candidates with up to 6 months of hands\-on experience who are eager to apply their skills in real\-world problem\-solving and research\-based projects.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Model Development:Design, develop, and implement ML/DL/AI models for diverse applications such as image processing, NLP, network security, or predictive analytics.
* Data Preprocessing: Clean, normalize, and transform raw datasets to ensure high data quality and integrity before analysis or model training.
* Algorithm Design:Create and optimize algorithms for big data processing, feature selection, feature engineering, and model training.
* Model Evaluation \& Tuning: Fine\-tune model hyperparameters and evaluate performance using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1\-score.
* Production Integration: Integrate models and data mining solutions into production environments and ensure they perform effectively at scale.
* Clean Code \& Documentation: Write modular, efficient, and well\-documented Python code following industry best practices.
* Data Visualization: Create meaningful visualizations to interpret model results and communicate insights to stakeholders.
* Team Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, software developers, and domain experts to understand project requirements and deliver solutions.
* Research \& Innovation: Stay updated with the latest trends in ML, DL, and AI; contribute to research efforts and recommend best practices.
* Documentation:Maintain detailed documentation for datasets, algorithms, models, and project processes.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Solid understanding of machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and AI concepts.
* Basic experience or academic exposure to tools like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, or Scikit\-learn.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably Google Cloud).
* Exposure to big data frameworks such as Hadoop or Apache Spark is a plus.
* Knowledge of networking concepts like MANET, VANET, and Bluetooth protocols is desirable.

* Recently completed or pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

 Netrix Global is seeking a
 **Network Engineer** 
 who will be responsible for maintaining and administering our client’s computer networks. Your primary duties will include maintenance of computer networks, hardware, software, and other related systems, performing disaster recovery operations, protecting data, software, and hardware from attacks, and replacing faulty network hardware components when necessary. You will also need to be able to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network devices including WAPs, firewalls, routers, switches, and controllers. * Performing disaster recovery operations and data backups when required.

* Troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and other network and system problems.
* Monitoring network performance to determine if adjustments need to be made.
* Conferring with network users about solving existing system problems.
* Operating master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.
* Coordinating computer network access and use.
* Provide specific detailed information for hardware and software selection.
* Ability to travel to client sites as needed, both locally and air travel in cases where necessary

* English language communication ability

**Additional Information**
 We appreciate if you have
   

  

* Experience of working abroad, especially projects in the Nordics

*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. title: Business Analyst - API
description:
**Req ID:** 
 364696
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Business Analyst \- API to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with a strong background in the Banking API domain to join our team. In this role, the Business Analyst will be responsible to drive the analysis, design, and implementation of API\-based solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with business and technical teams to gather requirements, define API specifications, and ensure seamless integration with banking systems. The candidate will have a minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience as Business Analyst in the Banking Industry.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Business \& Requirement Analysis:
* Gather and document business requirements for API development and integrations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (product owners, business teams, developers, and architects) to define API functionalities.
* Conduct gap analysis and feasibility studies to assess API needs for digital banking services.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and streamline business processes via APIs.
* API Design \& Development Support:
* Define API specifications (REST, SOAP, JSON, XML) and data models for seamless integration.
* Work closely with development teams to ensure APIs align with industry standards (Open Banking, PSD2, ISO 20022\).
* Define API security requirements including authentication.
* Assist in designing API error handling and logging mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and security policies for API\-driven banking solutions.
* Stakeholder Communication \& Coordination:
* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams, translating business needs into API specifications.
* Conduct workshops, meetings, and demos to ensure clear communication of API functionalities.
* Work with third\-party vendors, fintech partners, and external API consumers.
* Documentation \& Compliance:
* Prepare detailed API documentation including use cases, request/response formats, and integration guides.
* Ensure API governance policies are followed, aligning with Open Banking frameworks.
* Stay updated with banking regulations (e.g., GDPR, PSD2, PCI DSS) and ensure API compliance.
* API Performance Monitoring \& Support:
* Assist in monitoring API performance and analytics, identifying issues and improvement areas.
* Support post\-implementation reviews, API lifecycle management, and continuous improvements.


**Job Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or related field.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst for at least 6 to 8 years of experience preferably in API based Solutions in Banking Industry.
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, OpenAPI (Swagger).
* Experience with API tools such as Postman, MuleSoft, Apigee, or AWS API Gateway.
* Knowledge of API security standards (OAuth 2\.0, JWT, SAML, TLS, SSL).
* Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Basic understanding of databases (SQL, NoSQL) and integration with APIs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Visio, BPMN.
* Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams and manage multiple priorities.

 Forward Deployed AI Engineers embed with teams across Swiggy to solve their hardest problems using AI. You'll work in small pods, report into the Central AI team, and deploy to where the problems are: supply chain, category ops, marketplace, support, and beyond.
   

  

 Think of it as being the AI CTO for the domain you're embedded in.
   

  

**What qualities are we looking for?**
* Why did availability drop 15% in a zone last week? Build the prediction system that prevents it before it happens.
* Ops teams spend 3 days onboarding new catalog items. Can an agent do it in 20 minutes?
* The Dineout discovery bot answers questions but doesn't learn from mistakes. Make it self\-improving.

* MCP servers connecting AI to Swiggy's operational systems
* Evaluation frameworks that prove AI impact in production
* Self\-improving agents that learn from ops feedback loops

* Package what works into skills and playbooks others can use
* Your field learnings directly shape what the Central AI platform builds next

* Advanced context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and agent harness patterns
* Experience with skills, subagents, tool integration, and orchestration patterns
* You understand the gap between "it works locally" and "it works at scale with real latency and cost constraints"
* You apply first principles thinking to re\-imagine existing workflows in an AI native way.
* Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex is your primary environment. You ship faster with AI tools than without.
* You think in skills, subagents, and parallel workflows
* You can design an agent architecture, implement it, and iterate based on production feedback
* You've shipped at least one AI system that moved a real business metric. Not incremental, transformative.

* You know what it takes to get from prototype to production

title: Software Engineer -Backend
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr, our vision is a world where all businesses are powered by embedded payments. Modulr enables businesses, from SMEs to Enterprise, initially across the UK and Europe to efficiently pay\-in, collect and disburse funds instantly via a range of payment schemes, accounts, and card products.
   

  

 We have created an industry\-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. Our Vertical Solutions targets a growing range of industry verticals which directly connect their IT platforms to our APIs and webhooks. We solve complex payment problems for hundreds of clients in a range of industries, including Travel, Lending, Wage Advance, and Investment \& Wealth.
   

  

 We are deeply integrated into the payment eco\-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
   

  

 Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
   

  

 Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Team**
 At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in
   

  

 the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on
   

  

 a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross\-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
   

  

**Summary**
 In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr’s event\-driven payments platform. You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle—from shaping technical approaches to delivering production\-grade software—within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Specific duties
   

  

**Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design and develop backend services using Java (17\+) or similar OO languages.
* Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event\-driven components in a cloud\-native environment.
* Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability.
* Design clean, well\-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts.
* Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling.


 Distributed Systems \& Reliability
   

  

* Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability.
* Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services.
* Build systems with strong observability—logs, metrics, tracing—ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly.


**Quality \& Testing**
* Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber.
* Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team.
* Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long\-term technical health.


 DevOps, Cloud \& Tooling
   

  

* Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services).
* Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices.
* Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery.
* Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems.
* Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on.


**About You**
 You’re an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system\-level problems. You bring:
   

  

* Expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience building and operating microservices in production.
* Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement.
* Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality work.
* A growth mindset—you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow.
* A self\-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it’s also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

description:
**Description**
 Ready for a career\-defining opportunity to reinvent one of the world's largest ecommerce platforms? More than two million entrepreneurs in 172 countries sell on Amazon. The third\-party marketplace is one of the “three big pillars” that support all of Amazon (along with AWS and Prime), and is responsible for almost half of all sales on our retail websites. If you want to build websites that make big money and a big difference, this is the job for you.
   

  

 We are looking for a Front\-End Web Developer with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems on an unprecedented scale. You will build the next generation of our seller platform that will enable designers and developers to build beautiful, intuitive, responsive interfaces for all devices. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to create significant impact on our systems, our business and most importantly, our customers as we take on challenges that can reshape the e\-commerce industry.
   

  

 We are seeking someone who has strong technical and UX skills with a can\-do attitude and a focus on delivering high quality software. We move at a fast pace and deliver software iteratively using AGILE best practices and the latest technologies. We’re just getting started, so this is your chance to get in at the beginning and create the definitive ecommerce experience.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best UI technical design and approach for new product development.
* Instill best practices for UI development and documentation, assure designs meet requirements, and deliver high\-quality work on tight schedules.
* Operational Excellence \- monitoring \& operation of production services


**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of professional front end development experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Experience (non\-internship) in professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience with developing machine learning and natural language processing products

title: Manager Human Resources
description:
**Career Area:**


Human Resources**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Role Definition:**

  

Implements HR strategies aligned with business objectives, provides guidance on HR policies and practices, and fosters a culture of employee engagement and development.

**Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborating with management as a strategic advisor helping identify and prioritize HR initiatives that align with the organization's strategic goals and objectives.
* Aligning HR policies and programs for their business unit or region which promote employee engagement, retention, and performance.
* Acting as a trusted coach providing guidance to leaders and managers on HR\-related matters, including performance management, compensation, and benefits, etc.
* Analyzing HR metrics and data to identify trends and opportunities and develop a story to provide data\-driven recommendations to senior management.
* Leading team of HR professionals to collaborate effectively with other Centers of Excellence and serve as thought leaders to the business and HR.

Degree Requirement  

Degree or equivalent experience desired


Skill Descriptors  

Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
* Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
* Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
* Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area.
* Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.

Knowledge of Organization: Knowledge of the organization's vision, structure, culture, philosophy, operating principles, values, and code of ethics; ability to understand the value of aligning capabilities with business goals to support optimal performance.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Applies organization's operating principles and practices within own business unit.
* Supports the mission, vision, and objectives of own department or unit.
* Assesses local and industry examples of acceptable and unacceptable business practices.
* Obtains information regarding key players, key issues, and key strategies in own unit.
* Specifies the roles and responsibilities of own business unit.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision\-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision\-making process.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
* Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
* Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.


Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Develops basic persuasive arguments.
* Discusses organizational culture around providing input on decisions.
* Uses active listening skills and probing techniques to surface opportunities to influence.
* Identifies who the decision makers are and how they receive information.
* Regularly presents ideas or suggestions to associates in persuasive terms.

Leadership: Knowledge of leadership practices and processes; ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives while having a long\-term perspective of the future state of things and how to get there.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Utilizes an appropriate style of leadership: autocratic, democratic, laissez\-faire/free rein, etc.
* Utilizes positive reinforcement to motivate \& attain desired behaviors; increases productivity.
* Demonstrates leadership qualities: intelligence, dominance, persistence, integrity, confidence.
* Employs leadership theories, such as contingency and transactional, and associated techniques.
* Manages own behaviors during interactions, such as feedback giving, to shape workplace events.

Data Gathering and Reporting: Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Detects and summarizes patterns in data and findings by producing simple reports.
* Assesses common problems and obstacles surrounding data\-gathering.
* Customizes data fields to meet clients' needs.
* Interprets and explains results of a data\-gathering initiative.
* Participates in projects to gather data for needs analysis.

Employee Relations: Knowledge of the rights and obligations in the employee relations; ability to adhere to legal requirements when handling employee negotiations.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Assists employees with personal or professional problems.
* Conducts employee satisfaction surveys and documents interviewees' concerns and issues.
* Explains organizational policies, procedures and processes for dealing with employee relations issues.
* Addresses routine problems or disciplinary issues related to employee relations, such as grievances.
* Interprets and communicates employee relations policies and procedures at the local level.

Talent Management : Knowledge of how an organization attracts, recruits, retains, identifies and develops talent; ability to develop the talent required for an organization to achieve its short\-term and long\-term goals.  

Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Implements campaigns designed to attract talented individuals to the organization.
* Evaluates the competencies and personal attributes of prospective employees vs. desired qualities.
* Coordinates reward and recognition programs designed to retain desirable employees.
* Participates in assessing the competencies present in current members of the organization.
* Analyzes talent development needs and maintains a list of high\-potential employees.

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization.


**Additional information:** This job required 5days working from office.

**Posting Dates:**


March 23, 2026 \- April 6, 2026
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

description:
Overview:
**Payroll Analyst \- APAC****Location:** Bangalore**Experience:** 6 to 8 years
Reporting to : Senior Payroll Manager**About the Role:**
HealthEdge is expanding its Global Payroll team! We are seeking a Payroll Analyst – APAC to support India and the Philippines. This role will be responsible for end‑to‑end payroll processing for India and Philippines employee populations, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery. The role requires strong knowledge of statutory regulations, audit controls, payroll reconciliations, and cross‑functional collaboration with HR, Finance, and third‑party payroll vendors. **Key Responsibilities:*** **Payroll Processing \& Operations**
* Manage end‑to‑end payroll for India and Philippines, including inputs, validations, processing, and post‑payroll activities.
* Review and verify inputs such as new hires, exits, transfers, bonuses, overtime, and allowances.
* Coordinate with external payroll vendors for smooth data exchange and issue resolution.
* Perform detailed payroll reconciliations and variance analysis before final sign‑off.
* Ensure timely distribution of payslips, payroll reports, and bank files.
* Address payroll queries from employees through ticketing systems or email.
* Coordinate with banking partners for salary disbursements and related queries.
* Collaborate with HR, Finance, and other teams for seamless issue resolution.

* **Statutory Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with all statutory regulations for India (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Income Tax, Gratuity) and Philippines (SSS, PhilHealth, HDMF/Pag‑IBIG, BIR).
* Stay updated with legislative changes and apply them accurately to payroll.
* Manage statutory filings and returns as required.
* Maintain strong payroll controls and documentation.
* Ensure payroll data integrity and adherence to data‑privacy guidelines.

 **What We’re Looking For:*** Strong knowledge of payroll in APAC, including India \& Philippines.
* Expertise in end\-to\-end payroll processes and internal control concepts.
* Ability to assess business process changes and provide strategic input.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills with internal and external teams.
* Ability to work independently and across multiple time zones.
* Highly analytical, accurate, detail\-oriented, and proactive.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity, risk, and change.

**Skills \& Qualifications:*** 6–8 years of hands\-on payroll experience, with Mandatory exposure to India and Philippines payroll.
* Experience with GreytHR, Mynd; Workday or other HR systems is a plus.
* Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office skills; ability to handle large datasets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English required.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced environments with tight deadlines.
* Quick learner, adaptable, and able to prioritize multiple deadlines.

title: Deputy Director - Cybersecurity Lead BISO
description:
Overview:

The BISO Infosec Lead for Supply chain and Commercial and Consumer Function will serve as the primary Information Security (Infosec) Lead for PepsiCo’s Supply Chain (Africa, Middle East, South Asia, International Beverage) and Consumer \& Commercial (EMEA) functions. Provide trusted, business\-aligned security advisory and execution across the region to manage cyber risk, enable secure solution delivery (projects, IoT/Beyond‑the‑Bottle, blockchain), drive vulnerability and third‑party risk remediation, and embed security into processes and product lifecycles to protect data, operations, brand and stakeholder trust.
Responsibilities:

Individual Responsibilities* Lead security intake for Supply Chain \& Consumer/Commercial workstreams in scope; ensure timely assessment, prioritization and routing of information security requests and issues.
* Act as the regional escalation point to the Sector BISO and Global Information Security for gaps, risk exposures and remediation plans; track closure and report status.

Provide security advisory across project lifecycles (planning deployment* operations), including ISA onboarding, secure design reviews and security requirement definition.
* Drive vulnerability management and remediation coordination with owners and Deployment Leads; validate mitigations and report risk reduction.
* Support Application Risk Assessments, legacy remediation and DevSecOps coaching for Supply Chain engineering teams.
* Manage third party security interactions: assessments, remediation tracking and collaboration with TPRM and blockchain provenance teams.
* Support Incident Response and Enterprise Incident Management locally; coordinate stakeholders, containment and post incident remediation.
* Own stakeholder engagement and awareness: design and deliver security content, training, and governance briefings to gain business buy in.
* Contribute to M\&A/JV due diligence and onboarding for security posture, particularly for bottlers, suppliers and technology integrations.
* Ensure security considerations for data residency/GCC processing and Beyond the Bottle device lifecycles are considered.


Role activity balance (approximate)* Operational \& Executional: 50% (work intake, remediation coordination, incident support, TPRM execution)
* Tactical: 35% (project advisory, stakeholder engagement, process improvements, training)
* Strategic: 15% (policy alignment, capability uplift, regional security roadmaps and M\&A enablement)


Decision making autonomy* Medium: empowered to make technical and process decisions within agreed policy limits escalating higher risk or policy exceptions to Sector BISO.


Supervision required* Low to Medium: operates independently day to day; receives directional guidance and policy/strategy from Sector BISO and Global Security leads.


Role complexity* High: cross domain technical breadth (application security , infrastructure security, IoT, blockchain, cloud, identity), regulatory complexity (cross border data, GCCs), multi jurisdiction stakeholder landscape, and process\+system risk focus.


Cross functional interactions* High: frequent collaboration with Supply Chain ops, Deployment Leads, Data Science/Analytics, IT/Cloud, Legal \& Privacy, Procurement/TPRM, Compliance, HR (insider/process controls), Finance (CAPEX/Project funding), Commercial and Marketing for product/program enablement.


Success measures / KPIs (examples)* % remediation actions closed within SLA; reduction in open critical vulnerabilities across scope; % key partners with acceptable security posture; reduction in risk in new engagements and secure from Start


Shared Accountabilities
Co‑manage security intake and prioritization with Deployment Leads and Project Managers (shared ownership for timely delivery of secure solutions).
Collaborate with Sector BISO on regional risk escalations, exception decisions and remediation prioritization (shared accountability for risk acceptance/mitigation).
Jointly own third‑party remediation and contract security requirements with TPRM and Procurement (shared execution and follow‑up).
Support Incident Response with Global IR while local Ops and business leaders share containment, communications and remediation responsibilities (shared incident management).
Partner with Data \& Analytics leads on AI/model governance and with Legal/Privacy on cross‑border data transfer decisions (shared governance and control implementation).
Coordinate with Security Architecture and Solutions teams for design approvals and with Finance for project CAPEX/security funding estimates (shared planning and funding accountability).
Qualifications:

Yrs of Experience
9\-12 years as BISO/IT Security Architect/Engineer or similar experience  

Mandatory Technical Skills* Experience with security architecture, application risk analysis,vulnerability management, data classification, CIS Top 20Critical Controls
* CISM, CISSP, GIAC certifications preferred
* Well versed in NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* Well versed in Agile development methodology andDevSecOps framework

  

Mandatory Non\-Technical Skills* Bachelor’s degree required
* Written/spoken English proficiency required
* Strong interpersonal and oral communication skills
* Ability to translate highly technical information into plainlanguage
* High level of analytical and problem\-solving abilities

  

Differentiating Competencies* Highly self\-motivated and directed.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
* Willing "can do" attitude
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work across multiple organizations and teams

title: Senior Integration Analyst
description:
***We’re building the AI\-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth!***

Gainsight is the AI\-powered retention engine behind the world’s most customer\-centric companies. The Gainsight CustomerOS platform orchestrates the customer journey from onboarding to outcomes to advocacy. More than 2,000 companies trust Gainsight’s applications and AI agents to drive learning, adoption, community connection, and success for their customers. To explore how our suite of solutions is shaping the future of customer success, check out the link .


***About This Role:***

We’re looking for a full\-time Senior Integration Analyst to join our G\&A team reporting to the Associate Manager \- IT Applications. This role is a hybrid role based out of our Hyderabad, India location.


In this role, you’ll play a key role in enabling seamless integration between enterprise systems by designing and maintaining workflows on the Workato platform. You will help automate business processes and ensure reliable data exchange across applications. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys working cross\-functionally with business stakeholders and technical teams. The ideal candidate brings strong skills in integration development, automation, and troubleshooting.


***What You'll Do:***

* The Senior Integration Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining system integrations using the Workato integration platform.
* This role plays a key part in enabling seamless data exchange between enterprise applications such as ERP, CRM, HR, and other business systems.
* The analyst will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, and technical teams to gather requirements, build scalable integration workflows (recipes), and ensure reliable automation of business processes.
* The role also involves monitoring integration performance, troubleshooting issues, optimizing existing workflows, and implementing best practices for integration governance, security, and documentation.
* As a senior member of the team, the analyst will provide technical guidance, support complex integration projects, and help drive the organization’s automation and digital transformation initiatives through efficient and reliable integrations.

***This is not a complete list of responsibilities, and the scope of the role may evolve with the needs of the team and business. This role will require occasional travel for team meetings, training, or company events.***

***What We're Looking For:***

* 6\-8 years of relevant experience and a B.tech/B.E in Computer Science
* Hands\-on experience with Workato for building and managing integration recipes and automation workflows.
* Strong knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP), webhooks, and authentication methods for system integrations.
* Experience in integration design, data mapping, and transformation across enterprise applications.
* Ability to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration workflows to ensure reliability and performance.
* Strong requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration skills to translate business needs into integration solutions.

***Nice\-to\-have skills:***

* Experience integrating enterprise applications such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, or other SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of integration best practices and governance within iPaaS environments.
* Familiarity with scripting or data transformation tools (JavaScript, JSON, XML).
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance optimization for large\-scale integrations.
* Understanding of security and compliance considerations in system integrations.

***Why You’ll Love It Here:***

Gainsight is a place where innovation is shaped through collaboration, curiosity, and a shared focus on solving real\-world problems. With a growing suite of products across customer success, product experience, community, education, and AI\-powered relationship intelligence, we continue to evolve with the needs of our customers. When people with diverse strengths, a strong sense of community, and true passion for our mission come together, they drive greater impact and create lasting value. What underpins it all is a culture that offers the stability, trust, and support that people need \- not just to do the job, but to show up as themselves and feel connected to the work they do. Gainsters love working here for several reasons. Here are a few:


**Our Compensation and Benefits:** At Gainsight, we believe great work happens when teammates feel fully supported.


* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including full health coverage (including OPD), wellness and mental health resources, flexible remote work options, and childcare assistance. You'll also enjoy dedicated Recharge Holidays \- one long weekend each quarter to relax and reset.

**Our Core Values** : We are guided by our values and our mission to be living proof you can win in business while being Human\-First . Learn more here .


**Our Growth Opportunities** : From mentoring to career development opportunities, we’re passionate about helping our teammates learn, grow, and thrive.


**Our Parody Videos** : No explanation needed. Just watch them here!


**If this sounds like the right role for you, we’d love to hear from you.**

*Additional Information:*

*We’re committed to creating an inclusive, fair, and transparent hiring process. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a welcoming experience for all candidates.*

*If you require accommodations or have questions about how your personal data will be used during the hiring process, please contact* recruiting@gainsight.com *.*

*If you’re applying for a role through an Employer of Record (EOR) or contractor arrangement, please note that employment terms and benefits are managed by the EOR or may not apply to non\-EOR contractors.*

title: Retail District Manager
description:
DISTRICT MANAGER

  




PURPOSE \& OVERALL RELEVANCE FOR THE ORGANIZATION:

  



Drive own retail stores profitability by meeting or exceeding district sales and profit targets. Coaching Store Managers to drive commercial success and excel in customer service. Ensuring proper execution of established policies, procedures, initiatives and directives.  



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  




* Take full ownership of the district and its commercial success
* Analyze relevant data to probe and challenge the status quo with both Retail Back Office partners and Store Managers
* Coach Store Managers to increase their stores’ sales, productivity and profitability
* Ensure the legal and financial integrity of the district’s store portfolio
* Drive a service and selling culture in the district
* Spend focused time on the sales floor during store visits to determine service improvement opportunities and to coach the Store Managers
* Be a Brand Ambassador, consistently exhibiting the Brand Attitude and Values
* Ensure proper in\-store Brand execution, according to established standards and directives, in all stores within the district
* Facilitate the effective and timely delivery and execution of Foundational and Seasonal Brand and product training materials in the stores
* Plan and prioritize structured store visits to maximize the district’s performance
* Dedicate a minimum of 3½ days per week to completing store visits and ensure all stores in the district are visited at least
* Ensure compliance with established policies, procedures, initiatives and directives
* Assess and make recommendations to improve the commercial viability and availability of products for the district’s stores
* Manage loss prevention as well as health and safety risks
* Share inputs for recruitment, on\-boarding, training and development efforts in the district
* Own succession planning for the district
* Ensure compliance to established HR policies and procedures
* Create a high\-performance culture by setting clear expectations, analyzing performance and giving appropriate and prompt feedback, including actively managing poor performance
* Coach, motivate and inspire Store Managers to accomplish store goals and maximize their individual performance, both face\-to\-face and remotely.
* Share best practices to drive overall Market and Global retail performance

The energy of a newsroom, the pace of a trading floor, the buzz of a recent tech breakthrough; we work hard, and we work fast \- while keeping up the quality and accuracy we're known for. **What’s the role?**
We are looking for a team leader for our Engineering recruiting team, to lead a team of recruiters based in Pune. You will use your ideas, curiosity and market knowledge to set and implement innovative recruiting strategies, culminating in an outstanding candidate and internal client experience for our hiring teams. You will be part of a strong global leadership team, collaborating on global initiatives and the global Engineering talent acquisition strategy.  

On a day to day basis you are a player\-coach, recruiting for some of our business areas whilst developing and leading your team. You'll build strong advisory relationships with key business leaders on a global and regional level, develop a deep understanding of their objectives, products, people, and challenges, in order to bring the best candidates to the table. * Operate as a player\-coach within the recruiting team, taking the lead recruiting role with various businesses based on critical business challenges and opportunities
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the business and proactively advise hiring managers on an ongoing basis to understand their current and future hiring needs and strategy
* Have a strong development\-oriented and coaching approach
* Engage and retain top talent within your own team and the broader recruiting function
* Implement initiatives to foster an inspiring culture, where continuous improvement and change is the norm
* Partner with the various senior managers and our internal HR community to deliver against a bold hiring plan while building out our team, systems and processes
* Lead large initiatives, strategic projects and programs focused on equipping the business with the tools they need to hire top talent
* Support the business as an impactful coach and enhance efficiency, quality, and productivity for all talent acquisition priorities
* Partner in a talent management culture working closely with regional and global peers \- HR Business Partners, Talent Leadership \& Development, Diversity \& Inclusion, Employee Relations, and Immigration
* Engage in workforce planning, HR business planning and forecasting as well as establish and supervise retention metrics to measure the efficiency and effectiveness of hiring processes and approach
* Lead key projects and initiatives, both regionally and globally, to drive the execution of long\-term strategic recruitment efforts
* Leverage and interpret data to drive hiring strategy with the business
* Refine and increase the quality of search delivery, stay abreast of market trends affecting our businesses as well as employment trends
  

  

**You need to have:**
* 10\+ years of agency/search firm and/or in\-house experience recruiting and leading a team
* Extensive experience partnering with internal leaders to build and successfully implement talent acquisition strategies
* Strong relationship management, a consultative approach, the ability to influence multiple constituents without direct authority and optimally network within a heavily matrixed organization

* Ability to remain calm under pressure, multitask, be client\-focused, and adapt in a fast\-changing environment

* Experience using applicant tracking systems, human resources information systems, and other recruiting\-related applications
* Strong and effective presentation and communication skills with the ability to communicate and present to senior leaders with ease
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* A history of making data\-driven decisions
**We’d love to see:**
* Successful recruitment of experienced professionals within the Engineering space
* A passion for global financial markets, companies, and economies
* Demonstrated success driving diversity recruiting initiatives

**Role Summary:** This is a contract role focused on delivering specific, high\-impact projects related to the onboarding and management of vendors providing contingent worker (CW) services to BHI COE. The roles include selection, onboarding, and day\-to\-day operational management of vendors, onboarding of CW, integration of CW into business functions in the CoE. The core focus is on establishing tangible, documented deliverables, including cross\-functional project plans, governance models, and business intelligence assets. The Contract Program Manager is responsible for ensuring all services are delivered in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

**Key Project Deliverables \& Responsibilities:**

* **Project: Vendor Operations Governance and Performance Management**
* Establish and formalize the operating model for end\-to\-end vendor lifecycle management, including selection, onboarding, performance review, and off\-boarding for strategic partners.
* Develop a Vendor Performance Management framework, defining key metrics (KPIs) for operational efficiency, compliance, and service quality.
* Ensure all vendor services and contingent worker engagements comply with internal policy and external regulatory requirements (e.g., labor laws, proper classification).
* Integrate CW into business functions as per demand and business plan
* Monitor ongoing CW delivery quality \& utilization
* Establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for onboarding, knowledge transfer, and operational workflows related to CW staffing model
* Develop the control framework and quality assurance protocols for compliance, partnering with internal audit or risk functions as required.
* Develop and deliver vendor management and CW management specific business intelligence assets, including dashboards, KPIs, and scorecards, to track defined success metrics. Translate complex data into executive\-level insights and presentation assets.
**Key Skills:** Vendor management (VMO), contract negotiation and compliance, operational governance and control frameworks, service level agreement (SLA) monitoring. Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional coordination, operational project management, process mapping and readiness assessment. continuous improvement methodologies (Lean/Six Sigma good to have).

**Required Qualifications \& Experience:**

* Minimum 10 years of experience with extensive expertise (at least 5 years) in project\-based program management, strategic operations, or transformation roles.
* At least 5 years expertise in designing and delivering onboarding frameworks, vendor management operations (VMO), cross\-functional program management, or CoE operations in a consultancy capacity.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, essential for interfacing with senior executives.
* Strong problem\-solving orientation with a demonstrable bias for structured execution.
* Prior experience in global capability centers, shared services, or strategy functions is preferred.

**Contractor Status and Compliance:**

* This is a contract position. The individual or entity hired is an independent service provider and will not be an employee of the company or its affiliates.
* The contractor is solely responsible for compliance with all applicable local laws, regulations, compensation, licensing, insurance, privacy, and tax duties.
* The contractor must always ensure proper classification and payment according to the employment laws of their jurisdiction for any workers they may use.

**Successful Completion of Contract Looks Like:**

* The CoE Vendor Management Framework is operational and fully documented, for sustained operation.
* Strategic programs assigned during the contract period are executed on time, with measurable impact and documented closing reports.
* Governance models and SOPs are fully documented and ready for adoption across the CoE.
* Leadership is supported with delivered, functional, data\-driven BI insights and reporting tools.

title: HR Operations Lead
description:
**Founded in London, in 2010, Glassworks is a fresh London fashion brand – totally independent, style\-obsessed and passionate believers in bricks\-and\-mortar boutiques as well as streamlined digital shopping. Our design\-led stores and website are refreshed weekly with small runs of completely new fashion – meaning a constant feed of exciting new stuff to try on, helped along by the most dedicated and on it staff\-turned\-stylists on the planet. We are focused on scaling our ecommerce and retail channels in the UK and abroad – all whilst maintaining a strong design aesthetic, stylish atmosphere in store and strong customer focus.**

  



**The Role**


**We are looking for a hands\-on HR Operations Lead to bring structure, consistency, and process discipline to a growing business. Glassworks is scaling, but many HR and operational processes are still ad hoc and dependent on individual managers. This role is about building clear, repeatable systems that improve execution across the business.**


**This is a practical, build\-and\-improve role \- not purely strategic and not purely administrative. You will own recruitment operations, onboarding/offboarding, SOPs and training materials, KPI reporting, and day\-to\-day people operations improvement, working closely with leadership, managers, and external HR support.**

  



**Work Schedule/Location: 5 days per week, fully remote work.**

  



**What You Will Own**


* **Build and improve core HR and people processes (onboarding, offboarding, documentation, workflows)**
* **Own end\-to\-end recruitment operations, including pipeline management and candidate experience**
* **Own and improve our ATS (ClearCompany), including structure, workflows, reporting, and use of automation/AI**
* **Evaluate and recommend improvements to tools and systems as we scale**
* **Build and maintain SOPs and training materials in Notion (knowledge base), covering both HR and cross\-functional operational processes**
* **Work with the Senior Operations Manager and department leads to capture, standardise, and improve processes across the business**
* **Ensure SOPs are clear, practical, and consistently used by managers and teams**
* **Track and report on key HR and recruitment metrics (e.g. hiring pipeline, onboarding, training completion)**
* **Ensure employee records are accurate, secure, and audit\-ready in ADP (system of record)**
* **Maintain strong compliance discipline, working with our external HR partner where needed**
* **Identify gaps, prioritise improvements, and implement practical solutions that save time and reduce errors**

**What success looks like**


**In the first 3–6 months, success in this role would look like:**


* **Structured, consistent onboarding process**
* **Clear and well\-managed recruitment pipeline**
* **Improved ATS usage and visibility**
* **SOPs and training materials live and in use**
* **Clear HR metrics and reporting**
* **Reduced reliance on ad hoc communication**
* **Stronger process consistency and compliance**

**What we are looking for**


* **Experience in HR operations, people operations, or a similar role in a growing business**
* **Experience in HR operations / people operations in a growing business**
* **Strong experience in recruitment, onboarding, and process improvement**
* **Proven ability to build and implement processes (not just support them)**
* **Experience using and improving an ATS**
* **Good judgment on using AI/automation vs human decision\-making**
* **Strong organisation, attention to detail, and follow\-through**
* **Comfortable working in an unstructured, scaling environment**
* **Strong communication and stakeholder management skills**
* **Practical understanding of UK HR processes and compliance**
* **Experience with systems such as ADP, Notion, or similar tools**

**Especially strong candidates will be able to show examples of:**


* **Building onboarding or HR processes from scratch**
* **Creating SOPs or training systems**
* **Improving hiring speed, structure, or quality**
* **Introducing KPI tracking or reporting**
* **Improving ATS workflows or automation**
* **Bringing structure to previously inconsistent environments**
